name: workspace_list
description: List files and directories in the Host-authorized workspace using relative paths.

name: workspace_search
description: Search text in the authorized workspace; returns bounded relative paths, line numbers and text.

name: workspace_read
description: Read a workspace text file and its digest before editing. Binary and sensitive files are refused.

name: workspace_write
description: Create or edit a text file using the digest from workspace_read, or null only for a new file. Blocky project packages must be edited through CLI.

name: workspace_undo
description: Undo a recorded workspace change after Host verifies its current file version.

name: blocky_cli
description: Run actual Blocky CLI using a string argument array. Discover --version, command list, schema list/show and catalog. JSON output is automatic. $project is the isolated project input and mutation output, independent of workspace permissions. Create blocks using patch create $project --operations $json:<JSON operations document> --output $patch; then patch preview/apply $project --patch $patch (apply needs --output $project); finally project compile. $patch references the latest isolated patch, and $json: accepts valid compact or multiline JSON. project edit only edits/copies existing selections. Configure a field with project configure $project --module ID --block ID --field NAME --value TEXT --output $project. A nonzero exitCode is a failed command. BLK-CODING-CLI-ARGS means invalid arguments or unsupported command, not missing permissions. Only deterministic commands; no Shell or nested builder tasks.

name: workspace_check
description: Actually validate a verified file snapshot: JSON parsing or JavaScript syntax via Node --check. This never executes repository code. A failed check returns ok=false with a stable code and line; fix the file then check the new digest. Other test commands require a registered tool extension.

name: project_context
description: Read the latest isolated Blocky project candidate, target module and selection from Host. Use blocky_cli project compile for actual compiler diagnostics.
